findings.description: If a variable string is ever passed as the first argument (e.g., fprintf(stderr, user_msg)), attackers can inject format specifiers.
If untrusted text contains CR/LF or terminal escape sequences and is written to logs or a terminal, it can forge log entries or trigger terminal control sequences.
If untrusted text contains CR/LF or terminal escape sequences and is written to logs or a terminal, it can forge log entries or trigger terminal control sequences.
Avoid logging secrets, tokens, PII, stack traces, or internal state details.
Avoid logging secrets, tokens, PII, stack traces, or internal state details.
Ignoring I/O errors can hide failures (e.g., broken pipe). Check for errors when writing logs.
